title: designfuchen/word-atlas
why_read: An open-source illustrated IELTS vocabulary app with spaced repetition, useful for language learners but of limited interest to a software engineering audience.
analysis: This is a vocabulary-learning app combining illustrations, UK/US pronunciation audio, and FSRS (a modern spaced-repetition scheduling algorithm) to help students prepare for the IELTS English exam. The technical interest here is modest: using FSRS instead of older algorithms like SM-2 is a reasonable and current choice for spaced repetition apps, but it's not a novel contribution. It would appeal more to people in ed-tech or language learning than to a general engineering readership.
